messages:
Priya: quick thread about vendor_blob validation and handshake enforcement levels. we keep vendor_blob so private customers can add weird knobs, but we also need a safe way to validate and lint those blobs before binding. thoughts?

Omar: propose three validation modes: strict (reject unknown vendor keys), permissive (accept but warn), and sandbox (simulate + run adapter conformance tests). tenants choose mode; hosted default=permissive with warnings, enterprise/private may pick strict or sandbox.

Lin: sandbox mode sounds useful. adapter runs local schema lint + conformance vectors and returns a `lint_report` with errors/warnings and a short fingerprint. control plane stores the fingerprint and refuses bind on critical errors in strict mode.

Zoe: operational caveat: strict mode increases churn for infra teams managing private on-prem adapters. we need an automated fix path: if lint errors are simple (deprecated keys), adapter can return an auto-migration suggestion in the lint_report so console can present a one-click apply.

Priya: good. also need runtime defenses: even if permissive accepted, runtime should enforce a small whitelist of top-level routing/telemetry keys that vendor_blob cannot override (e.g., region, sensitivity, observability_policy). vendor_blob is namespaced but cannot change those invariants.

Omar: agree. enforcement layers: 1) pre-bind lint per tenant mode, 2) simulate call to adapter (dry-run) to preview translation, 3) post-bind conformance check (first N requests compared to baseline semantic digest). failures trigger automatic remediation or rollback depending on tenant policy.

Lin: about schemas: encourage adapters to publish a JSON Schema for vendor_blob under their registration metadata. control plane can run local JSON Schema validation during lint and surface precise errors. schema versioning: adapters should include `vendor_schema_version` and `schema_hash` in registration.

Zoe: UX: console shows vendor_blob diff with schema errors inline, an auto-fix suggestion where possible, and a simulate button that runs sandbox tests (if tenant opted). make sandbox results ephemeral and redact any infra internals.

Priya: security: vendor_blob lint must never transmit customer secrets. require adapters to mark secret_refs in vendor_blob with placeholder tokens in lint/sim outputs. adapter must resolve secrets only at bind time inside its secure boundary.

Omar: metrics: collect a small `validation_signal` per bind: {mode: permissive|strict|sandbox, lint_errors_count, sim_warnings_count, postbind_divergence_score}. these are useful for platform health and to tune defaults. keep metrics low-cardinality.

Lin: testing & rollout: we'll prototype a `vendor-lint` microservice in SDK that can run JSON Schema checks + a set of deterministic sanitizers. adapters can import it to ensure parity.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-8123: "vendor_blob-validation-modes + sandbox-sim + console-autofix"  assignees Priya, Lin.

Zoe: action items: Priya draft policy doc for validation modes, Lin build SDK lint prototype, Omar add metrics + policy hooks to binding flow. target RFC + prototype in 9 business days. :calendar:
